faq: What is the best class in MapleStory Classic?

There's no single best class. For most players Fighter is the safest pick: top-tier grinding, tanky and easy on mana. Bandit has the highest boss damage, Hunter is the best ranged grinder, and Cleric is the best party support.
What's the best class for beginners?
Fighter or Page. Both have simple builds, take hits well and use little mana, so mistakes don't get you killed.
What's the best class to solo level?
Fighter, Page and Hunter. All three hit groups of monsters, and Hunter does it from a safe distance.
Is Assassin good in MapleStory Classic?
Assassin is great for bosses and safe ranged damage, but it has no attack that hits several monsters in 2nd job and restocking throwing stars costs mesos, so it levels slower than Hunter or Fighter.
In a party, yes: Heal and Bless make everyone stronger. Alone it's the slowest job to level because it has almost no way to hit groups (except healing undead monsters).
Can I change my job later?
No. Your 2nd job choice is permanent. Even fixing a misplaced AP or SP point costs 7,000 NX, so pick with care.
